name: @lituus-io/tetromino
description: Seven tiny animated four-block SVG icons. Dependency-free, recolourable with one CSS variable, under 1.5 KB each.
author: lituus-io <spicyzhug@gmail.com>

scripts.test: python3 scripts/check.py && node --input-type=module -e "import s,{names,dataUri} from './index.js'; if(names.length!==7||!dataUri('t').startsWith('data:image/svg+xml,'))process.exit(1); console.log('ok: js entry')"
